full_judgment: 9. Mr. AFM Shahid, the learned Deputy Attorney-General, on the other hand, submits that the prosecution has been able to prove its case of dacoity with murder vis-a-vis the place, time and the manner of occurrence by sufficient and reliable evidence. He further submits that PWs 3-5 are the most natural and reliable eye-witnesses and they have proved the occurrence. The learned Deputy Attorney-General submits that during the dacoity two victims namely, Dilip and Pintu were done to death. So far victim Dilip is concerned he died instantaneously and the other victim Pintu received stabbing injury on his abdomen during the occurrence by one of the dacoits and as a result he died in the hospital on the following day. Thus it is a clear case of dacoity with murder and the same has been sufficiently proved by oral evidences by other witnesses and the medical reports and evidence of the Dr. PW 16. Further contention of the learned Deputy Attorney-General as regards the recognition of the accused is that they have been seen at the time of occurrence and recognised at the TI parade held subsequently within the jail. The condemned prisoner Musa has been recognised by the eye-witnesses and in spite of some irregularities as contended by the other side in holding the TI parade, the same can be relied upon in view of the presumption that arises under section 11 of the Evidence Act. Hence the recognition based in the TI parade has been rightly given due weight by the trial Court. As regards the confessional statement of accused Md. Anowar Bagaiya, the learned Deputy Attorney-General submits that it is true that the confessional statement was recorded on a plain paper but for that it cannot be said the confessional statement is not voluntary and there may be some irregularities in recording the confession but those cannot be deemed to be fatal after examination of the recording Magistrate as a witness in this case.
